name: agy-terminal
description: Expose a real agy/Gemini MCP tool connected to the user-opened visible terminal. Auto-approves only scoped file-edit confirmations; shell, OAuth, and out-of-scope files are never auto-approved.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded work to local AGY/Gemini (v0.4.1)
interface.longDescription: Routes agy_run calls to the AGY terminal the user opened in the project directory. Per-cwd session routing ensures Project A never receives Project B's tasks. Call agy_status first to verify both ready: true and a nonzero agyPid. agy_run accepts task, mode, cwd, editableFiles, and timeoutSeconds (target parameter must be omitted). File-edit confirmations within editableFiles are auto-approved; shell commands, OAuth, and out-of-scope writes are always blocked.
defaultPrompt: Check AGY session status with agy_status first (requires ready: true and nonzero agyPid).
Use AGY for a read-only review: agy_run({ task: '...', mode: 'review', cwd: '...' }).
Use AGY to implement a bounded change: agy_run({ task: '...', mode: 'worker', cwd: '...', editableFiles: [...], timeoutSeconds: 900 }).
